title: Household Waste Survey and Characterisation in Gulu City, Uganda
text: figure generation--area shows per capita waste generation rate 94 households included study’s averages, one point per household, grouped study area ordered median area. Generation differs areas two divisions, every area households generate far rest.
code: library(guluswm) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2)  analysed <- guluswm_waste |>   filter(included_in_averages == "Yes") |>   mutate(area = reorder(area, generation_kg_cap_day, FUN = median))  medians <- analysed |>   group_by(area, division) |>   summarise(median = median(generation_kg_cap_day), n = n(), .groups = "drop")  ggplot(analysed, aes(x = generation_kg_cap_day, y = area)) +   geom_jitter(aes(colour = division), height = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +   geom_point(data = medians, aes(x = median), shape = 124, size = 8) +   geom_text(data = medians, aes(x = 1.45, label = paste0("n = ", n)),             hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +   scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.6), breaks = seq(0, 1.5, 0.25)) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Bardege-Layibi` = "#B5473B",                                  `Laroo-Pece` = "#5B8E7D")) +   labs(x = "Waste generation (kg per person and day)", y = NULL,        colour = "Division",        title = "Household waste generation by study area, Gulu City, 2026",        subtitle = "One point per household; the bar marks the median of the area") +   theme_minimal() +   theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Household survey on solid waste management in Gulu City, Uganda, 2026 — guluswm_survey
text: tibble 424 rows 43 variables household_id Identifier interviewed household assigned study team: two letters enumerator, survey month (2309 September 2026) running number, example AC-2309-001. enumerator Code enumerator conducted interview, E1 E5; codes replace mWater user names shared guluswm_waste. survey_date Date interview, 23 26 September 2026. area Study area household lives: Limo, Vanguard Highland (Laroo-Pece Division), Kanyagoga, Pabbo Quarters Goans Quarters (Bardege-Layibi Division). raw file spells Pabbo Quarters Pabwo Quarters sheet. division Administrative division Gulu City household lives: Bardege-Layibi Laroo-Pece. household_size Number people living household. respondent_is_head Whether respondent head household (Yes ). education_head Highest level education household head, rising order: None, Primary, Secondary, Tertiary/vocational, University . livelihood Main source livelihood household: Trading/business, Casual labour, Salaried employment, Remittances/Donations . income_band Monthly household income Ugandan shillings, six bands None/regular income UGX 1,000,000. income_class Income class derived income_band: Low (regular income UGX 300,000), Middle (UGX 300,000 600,000) High (UGX 600,000). expenditure_band Monthly household expenditure basic needs Ugandan shillings, five bands UGX 100,000 UGX 1,000,000. wall_material Main material walls dwelling: Mud/wattle, Unburnt bricks, Burnt bricks unplastered, Burnt bricks plastered . roof_material Main material roof dwelling: Grass thatch, Iron sheets (old/rusted), Iron sheets (new) Tiles/permanent. piped_water Whether household access piped water (Yes ). electricity Whether household access electricity (Yes ). waste_types Types waste household generates, named respondent: Food preparation waste, Food leftovers, Plastic, Paper, Glass ; several answers separated semicolon. disposal_container Container household stores waste disposal: Kavera (polyethylene bag), Sack, Bucket Bag; several answers separated semicolon. disposal_method household disposes waste: Burning, Collected service provider, Taken collection point/skip, Backyard dumping, Rubbish pit, Roadside dumping, Open drain, Burying, Garden/compost ; several answers separated semicolon. waste_collector collects household's waste: City/Division Council, Private Operator, Informal Collector, Community Group, Self (household), one ; asked households collection arrangement. preferred_frequency Collection frequency household prefer: Daily, week, Three times week, Twice week, Weekly, Collection points every month . preferred_time Time day household considers best collection: Morning, Day time, Evening, specific time . service_reliable Whether household considers collection service reliable (Yes ); asked households service. irregular_collection_problem Main problem household experiences irregular collection: Dirty neighborhood, Unhealthy environment, Spread diseases, Bad reputation area ; asked households call service unreliable. enough_collection_points Whether household considers number skips collection points area enough (Yes ). distance_disposal_point Distance household nearest disposal point, bands: Less 50 Metres, 50 - 100 Metres, 200 - 300 Metres 500 Metres. pays_for_collection Whether household pays waste collection (Yes ). current_fee_band Monthly fee household pays collection Ugandan shillings, five bands UGX 1,000 UGX 15,000 ; asked paying households. current_fee_rating household rates fee pays: Affordable, Manageable Expensive; asked paying households. payment_channel household pays collection: Direct City/Division Council, landlord . payment_schedule often household pays collection: Daily, Whenever collected, Bi-weekly Monthly. willing_to_pay Whether household willing pay improved regular collection service, pay now pays already (Yes ). reason_willing Main reason willing pay: Desire cleaner environment, Reduced risk disease, Convenience/saves time, Improves property value . reason_not_willing Main reason willing pay: Income low/irregular, Government/City bear cost, Already pay enough / rent includes , Current service unreliable pay , . wtp_band Monthly amount household willing pay Ugandan shillings, five bands UGX 1,000 UGX 15,000 ; asked willing households. preferred_payment_structure Payment structure household prefers: Flat monthly fee, Pay-per-visit/per-collection, Pay-per-bag/per-bin collected, Included property rent/rates preference. participates_cleanups Whether household takes part community clean-exercises (Yes ). ever_complained Whether household ever complained solid waste management (Yes ). complained_to household complained: LCI Chairman (chairperson Local Council ), Land Lord, City/Division Council, Private Operator . receives_swm_information Whether household receives information solid waste management City (Yes ). aware_of_bylaws Whether household aware solid waste management -law (Yes ). swm_challenges Challenges solid waste management area, coded study team respondent's answer; several codes separated semicolon. improvement_themes Improvements suggested respondent, coded study team free text answer; several codes separated semicolon.
